Users Ops Get User Admin Entitlements
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/users/:id/admin-entitlements

Retrieves the administrative entitlements for a specific user by their user ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

The user ID of the individual whose admin entitlements are being retrieved.

Responses
​
200
401

The request was successful, and returns a list of administrative entitlement objects.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA

roles
object[]
REQUIRED
scope
object
REQUIRED
service
object
REQUIRED
]
